# golden-noop

A parity test fixture for the [haxtheweb/create](https://github.com/haxtheweb/create) golden suite, not a plugin anyone installs.

It subscribes to every core hook the golden cases' routes fire and hands each hook its subject back unchanged. The golden suite runs with it switched on (`--noop-plugin`) to show that turning the plugin platform on, with a plugin that does nothing, changes nothing a site ends up with: every case must still match its committed snapshot on haxcms-nodejs and haxcms-php.

## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `entity.before.create` | an entity is about to be created (any entity type the subscription lists) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `entity.before.read` | an entity or list is about to be read | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `entity.before.update` | an entity is about to be updated | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `entity.before.delete` | an entity is about to be deleted | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `entity.after.create` | the entity was created and stored | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `entity.after.read` | the entity or list was loaded | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `entity.after.update` | the update was stored | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `entity.after.delete` | the entity was deleted | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `page.before.save` | page content or metadata is about to be written (editor save, CLI, import) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `page.before.delete` | a page is about to be deleted (outline editor, CLI) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `page.after.save` | the page was written to disk | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `page.after.delete` | the page was deleted | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `file.before.save` | a file is about to be uploaded or its record changed (file manager, editor upload, appstore upload target) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `file.before.delete` | a file is about to be deleted | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `file.after.save` | the file is stored | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `file.after.delete` | the file was deleted | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `manifest.before.save` | site.json is about to be written (outline change, settings save, theme change) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `theme.before.change` | a site's theme is about to change (site settings, CLI) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `config.before.read` | a plugin's configuration is about to be read (subscription `config` list decides whose) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `config.before.save` | configuration is about to be written (dashboard, `hax plugin config set`, install migration) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `git.before.commit` | HAXcms is about to make a git commit for a site (after a page or manifest save) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `transaction.before.start` | a unit of work is about to start; every operation runs in one (a single save gets an implicit one, the outline editor or an import opens an explicit bulk one) | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `transaction.before.end` | the work is done and the transaction is about to close | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `rest.before.request` | a request to a plugin or core route is about to reach its handler | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.before.create` | a site is about to be created | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.before.duplicate` | a site is about to be duplicated | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.before.archive` | a site is about to be archived | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.before.delete` | a site is about to be deleted | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.before.export` | a site is about to be exported | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `user.before.login` | a user is about to login | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `user.before.logout` | a user is about to logout | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `manifest.after.save` | site.json was written | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `theme.after.change` | the theme change was saved | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `config.after.read` | the configuration was loaded | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `config.after.save` | configuration was written; requirements are re-evaluated after this | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `git.after.commit` | the commit was made | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `transaction.after.start` | the transaction is open | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `transaction.after.end` | the transaction closed | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `rest.after.request` | the handler produced a response, before it is sent | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.after.create` | the site was created | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.after.duplicate` | the site was duplicated | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.after.archive` | the site was archived | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.after.delete` | the site was deleted | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `site.after.export` | the site was exported | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `user.after.login` | the user login finished | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `user.after.logout` | the user logout finished | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `render.before.head` | the head is about to be assembled | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `render.after.head` | the head is assembled | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `render.before.body` | right after the opening body tag | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `render.after.body` | right before the closing body tag | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `render.before.content` | the page content is about to be placed in the shell | Hands the subject back unchanged. |
| hook | `render.after.content` | the content is placed | Hands the subject back unchanged. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs` and `src/php`.
